Why would anyone pay $41 billion for one pill?

On Nov 24, 2026, Sanofi agreed to buy Insmed for $175 a share in cash, about $41.0 billion, roughly 46% above Insmed's Nov 18 close (before deal reports). The prize is Brinsupri, a lung disease pill launched in the US in August 2025, which the companies say brought in $1.09 billion through Sep 30, 2026. Fierce Pharma reports Sanofi needs new growth ahead of a Dupixent patent cliff. The deal needs shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to close in the first half of 2027.
